cohort: Women of any age, parity, and booking status who underwent emergency peripartum hysterectomy within 24 hours of delivery through any mode at the Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics, Mardan Medical Complex, Mardan from February 2017 to July 2017.
finding: The incidence of emergency peripartum hysterectomy (EPH) was 0.1%, with the most common indication being uterine rupture followed by atonic uterus, and was associated with high rates of maternal (14.3%) and perinatal (52%) mortality.
